name: Tactical Annihilation
description:
About This Game

Tactical Annihilation is a sci-fi turn-based strategy game played on a hexagonal grid.

It features full base-building mechanics, a rich variety of unit types, and innovative sci-fi themed systems.

Combat operations are optimized for intense engagements—you can box-select and directly command multiple units at once, and offload non-critical units to an AI-assisted decision system.

The game includes over 70 unit and building types, covering complete land, sea, and air forces, defensive structures, and colossal mega units that can turn the tide of battle in a single stroke.

12 commanders grant special abilities to your troops, along with powerful skills capable of reshaping the battlefield.

▶ Streamlined Controls & AI Assistance

Box-select multiple units for collective orders, making it easy to command vast armies. In the later stages, use the AI-assisted decision system to handle non-critical units, so you can focus your attention on decisive engagements.

▶ Base Building & Economic Management

Unlike many other strategy games, this title incorporates base construction and economic operations. Build economic structures, factories, defense towers, and even deploy long-range artillery batteries to turn defense into offense.

▶ Mega Units

Transform your economic advantage into an unstoppable force that crushes enemy lines.

Build the massive armored tank, the colossal airship, or the gigantic missile-spider!

▶ Diverse Units

Over 70 unit and building types, including a complete roster of naval, ground, and air forces, plus defensive towers.

In addition, there are spider units that can scale hills and hover units that glide over lava.

▶ Choose Your Commander

Pick from 12 unique commanders to grant passive traits to your forces, and unleash game-changing active skills that can turn the tables.

Rich Game Content

✓ Campaign mode with 26 missions—learn the units and master the rules.

✓ BattleSpace mode—extra challenge scenarios across 30 maps.

✓ Highly customizable Skirmish mode with 20+ maps, supporting up to 8 players.

✓ Built-in powerful map editor with trigger-based scripting.
short_desc: Experience turn-based strategy with free-form base building, multi-unit control, colossal units, and powerful battle skills. It captures the depth of an RTS in turn-based form, like Advanced Wars with massive super units!
